name: pivotkit-monorepo
description: Repository root of pivotkit: npm workspaces for pivotkit-core, pivotkit-react, pivotkit-element, pivotkit-xlsx, pivotkit-report, pivotkit-cli, pivotkit-server and pivotkit-mcp, the playground (examples/playground) and its browser tests (tests/browser).

scripts.test: node scripts/test-run.js npm test --workspaces --if-present && node scripts/test-run.js node --test "tests/*.test.js"
scripts.types: npm run types --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:types --workspaces --if-present
scripts.pack:check: node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-core && node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-react && node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-element && node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-xlsx && node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-report && node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-cli && node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-server && node scripts/check-pack.js pivotkit-mcp
scripts.build:playground: node examples/playground/build.js && node packages/pivotkit-element/build.js && node packages/pivotkit-xlsx/build.js && node tests/browser/pages/build.js
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:playground && node scripts/test-run.js playwright test
